verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents Auto-Sync, which commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected, and Background Sync, which keeps this running while you use other apps, though it pauses after long idle periods and uses location and battery. It also exposes automation via Shortcuts actions and x-callback-url. However, the only truly autonomous background behavior documented is this fixed sync loop, and the Repository Agent is conversational rather than autonomous. missing for 10: user-defined autonomous/scheduled automations beyond sync, background agent execution without user interaction, independent or hands-on corroboration of background reliability.
